fr40-commit-title-id-duration.packet:
- [r-commit-title-id] A worker receives the task id in its brief and uses it in every commit title, ending the title with the id in parentheses, for example `Add a parser (<task id>)`.
- [r-node-test] Tests use node:test and node:assert/strict under test/, mirroring the src area they cover.
- [r-role-names] Name files, functions, tests and work by purpose and role, never by phase, slice, ticket, round, date or version: no task ids or dates in new file names or identifiers.
- [r-shard-weights] A new test file needs a weight in scripts/lib/shard-weights.mjs; npm run fast reports a missing one.
- [r-tracker-owner] Task status lives in tasks/<id>.json and only the lead changes it with krn task (ready, claim, release, close). A worker never edits, closes or deletes a tracker file, even when its task is finished.
- [r-unknown-command] When the CLI receives an unknown command it fails with exit 64 and a message naming the command, and never forwards it to another binary.
- [r-core-imports] When core code is changed, keep imports within core: src/core imports only its own files, including nested files and every module form. Core stays independent of replaceable adapters; scripts/boundaries.ts holds the layer map and fails on a forbidden import.
- [r-deep-modules] Prefer deep modules with small interfaces and substantial work behind them.
- [r-regression-layer] When a defect is fixed, its regression test goes at the lowest layer that reproduces it.
